name: webmd
description: 个人 Wiki：静态 HTML + GitHub 风 Markdown

scripts.build: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.node.json && vite build && tsx scripts/build-site.ts
scripts.search-index: tsx -e "import {buildSearchIndex} from './scripts/lib/search-index.ts';import fs from 'fs';import path from 'path';const c=path.join(process.cwd(),'content');const i=buildSearchIndex(c);fs.mkdirSync('public',{recursive:true});fs.writeFileSync('public/search-index.json',JSON.stringify(i));console.log('[search-index]',i.docs.length,'docs');"
